justification: All four critical facts are clearly present and correctly stated: 8 available vs reorder point of 20, ORD-007 demanding 50 units (well above the threshold), 3-day supplier lead times from SUP-001 and SUP-004, and a diagnosis that correctly attributes the problem to reorder point/demand mismatch rather than supplier failure. The only notable omission is the important (non-critical) fact about PO-008 in transit with 150 units arriving after ORD-007's required date. All other data points, IDs, and values are consistent with the ground truth.
facts_found: Available stock: 8 units, reorder point: 20, needs_reorder: true
ORD-007 processing/urgent with 50 units of PROD-001, overdue (required 2026-02-12)
SUP-001 lead time 3 days, SUP-004 lead time 3 days
Diagnosis explicitly links shortfall to reorder point vs large single-order demand spike
Recommendation to raise reorder point to 60-70 units and add workflow for large urgent orders
Suppliers not blamed; both rated reliable (4.0-4.5/5)
facts_missing: PO-008 in transit with 150 units and its expected arrival relative to ORD-007's required date
